StyleStream 1.0 introduced the first streamable zero-shot VSC system with state-of-the-art conversion quality, but remained limited in two ways: approximately 1s end-to-end latency on consumer hardware, and the lack of a text-based interface for designing or editing target voices. Earlier open-ended benchmarks give each agent a problem statement and grade one program after the run. FrontierCS 2 places the agent inside a research environment. items.title: Language Models Learn to Improve Language Models
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate AI research, including language-model (LM) development, offering a potential path toward recursive self-improvement. However, turning experimental feedback into a learned ability to propose effective improvements across models faces two challenges. items.summary: Agents need reliable ways to validate their outputs, both when completing tasks and when filtering synthetic training data. items.title: Looped Uniform Diffusion Language Models
items.summary: Uniform diffusion language models (UDLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising sequences of ordinary vocabulary tokens, any of which may be corrupted and subsequently revised. During training, UDLMs must denoise from a context that may itself be unreliable, whereas masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) always condition on a clean context. This challenging training objective makes UDLMs more FLOP-intensive to train than MDLMs, but it yields stronger downstream reasoning performance. items.summary: Methods for training language models on sensitive data differ in how they balance capability gains against the risk of leaking private information. In this paper, we present a controlled comparison of data-level and training-level interventions for navigating the capability-privacy tradeoff on synthetic medical records with canaries to probe for leakage. items.summary: Diffusion language models form answers through a sequence of revisable continuous states, but multi-agent systems usually discard those states and make agents communicate only after decoding text. We ask whether one independent diffusion trajectory can pass a compact hidden message into another and, crucially, whether the receiver uses what that message means. items.summary: Deep research systems iteratively plan, gather evidence, synthesize, and revise, making end-to-end latency a key bottleneck for interactive use. Almost all production systems are built on autoregressive (AR) language models and inherit left-to-right decoding in planning and long-form writing. items.title: ToM2Vec: Continuous Theory-of-Mind Tokens for Multi-Agent Coordination
items.summary: Forming an accurate theory-of-mind (ToM) is key to successful multi-agent collaboration and requires reasoning under uncertainty to capture multiple possible partner states. This is hard to do in the text representation space native to large language model (LLM) agents, which more easily describe a single partner state. To address this challenge, we introduce ToM2Vec, which learns to form abstract theories-of-mind in a rich latent space via a fixed budget of continuous reasoning tokens. items.title: Design Anything, Design at Scale
items.summary: As multimodal resources are transformed into media outputs, agentic AI is expected to stay aligned with design intent over long horizons. Designers follow briefs specifying goals, constraints, and deliverables, with later work building on earlier decisions. Recent work reuses design experience across tasks, yet alignment among artifacts within one project remains challenging. items.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation Compositionality
items.summary: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds large language models in external knowledge. Modern pipelines combine embedding, chunking, retrieval, reranking, query augmentation, context compression, and agentic verification, yet these techniques are typically evaluated one at a time. It remains unclear whether their isolated gains survive composition, whether retrieval quality and answer faithfulness favor the same design choices, and whether conclusions from small corpora hold at large scale. items.summary: Practitioners use reinforcement learning methods for language models through training frameworks, so a method that a framework includes is one configuration change away for its users. We measure how often this happens. items.summary: We present WorldStream, an open-ended 3D world model with three simultaneous capabilities: it extends playable terrain beyond any pre-specified map, acts on open-ended language in the running world, and restores visited places with their edits. items.title: SpatialScout: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore and Map 3D Scenes?
items.summary: Spatial intelligence requires agents to actively acquire visual evidence and integrate observations into a coherent representation of the three-dimensional world. Yet spatial question answering offers limited evidence of whether models can construct accurate metric maps through autonomous exploration. We introduce SpatialScout, a benchmark for evaluating vision-language model (VLM) agents on active object-level 3D mapping. items.summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models achieve strong performance across embodied manipulation tasks by unifying visual understanding, language conditioning, and action generation. However, long-horizon tasks can involve non-Markovian dependencies: successful decisions may require retaining task progress and past interaction outcomes, while partial observability and execution errors compound over time. items.summary: Reconstructing 3D scenes from sparse views without per-scene optimization remains highly challenging, especially for recovering accurate geometry and fine textures. While recent feedforward approaches leverage generalizable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) for scene generation, they typically assign one or multiple Gaussians to each pixel. items.summary: A login screen that appears after a tap on Sign in is expected; the same screen after a tap on View order is an attack. items.summary: Linear-attention language models keep their context in a recurrent state of fixed size, where an inference system stores one copy of this state for every sequence it decodes at the same time. Storing the state at lower precision therefore lets more sequences share an accelerator. items.summary: This paper addresses the problem of creating immersive volumetric videos from sparse and low-resolution capture resources. Conventional dense multi-view reconstruction methods can produce high-quality volumetric videos, but their reliance on costly capture setups makes them impractical in real-world scenarios. items.summary: Multimodal code intelligence connects the symbolic world of programs with the visual world their execution creates. Interest in this capability is burgeoning, as models are increasingly asked to produce charts, webpages, animations, and semi-structured documents. Recently, proprietary models have pushed far ahead, producing interactive artifacts even from a text description or a screenshot alone. items.summary: Language models' abilities to interpret tasks and generate programs offer a promising basis for 3D spatial reasoning. items.title: A Quasipolynomial Algorithm for $\ell_\infty$ Contractions
items.summary: We give an algorithm for computing an $\eps$-approximate fixed point of any $d$-dimensional nonexpansion with respect to the $\ell_\infty$ norm in time $\log(1/\eps)^{O(\log^2 d)}$. At its core, our method uses a boosting argument to geometrically shrink a search region. Among other consequences, our algorithm implies that simple stochastic games can be solved in quasipolynomial time.

items.summary: The success of convolutional neural networks is often attributed to locality and weight sharing. items.summary: IROS 2026 最佳论文启示录：没有长记忆的机器人，终将被淘汰。 作者丨 邓哲敏 编辑丨 齐铖湧 本月初在匹兹堡闭幕的 IROS 2026 将最佳论文奖颁给了 LT-Mem，这项研究让机器人重访同一空间时，能完整保留每个物体的位置变迁史，而非仅仅记住最新一次看到的样子。评委会从近两千篇收录论文中选中它，想必不仅是认可其扎实的工作，也是代表学界宣告： 具身长记忆（long-term embodied memory）已经从一个工程补丁，变成了机器人领域公认的科学问题。 从实际角度考虑，通用机器人要规模化落地，需要以小时、天乃至周为单位持续运行，而不只是几分钟。没有长记忆，每次相遇都是初次见面，机器人只是一个个孤立的单次动作执行器；有了长记忆，它才能从一次性工具变成可以长期上岗的同事。 但解决这件事远不是扩大上下文窗口那么简单：持续涌入的多模态数据既无法全部存储，也无法全部检索；现实世界还在不断变化，新的观察既不能简单覆盖旧的，也不能无序堆叠；更棘手的是，一条错误的记忆会在之后的决策里被反复调用，错误由此层层放大。记忆如何写入、如何留证、如何纠错，都是需要被正面回答的问题，靠调几个工程参数解决不了。 AI科技评论（雷峰网公众号）注意到，在这一方向被顶会加冕的数月前，国内具身初创公司贝塔无限就已坐上牌桌。今年五月，贝塔的联合创始人陶帅在采访中明确表示： 长效、多模态、时空记忆的缺失 ，…

items.title: 关于手动剃刀，最近从吉列换成舒适了，消费降级，体验没降。
items.summary: 一直用的是吉列的锋隐致护刀头，用了六年，感觉耐久度越来越低，我一周差不多刮个五次左右，一个多月就感觉刀头钝了，剃须时有拉扯感，想要有更好的剃须体验，只能换新刀头。 查了一下，吉列在出了新款后，会把老刀头转到越南工厂生产，现在只有最新的极光系列刀头是在美国产的，本来想直接换成极光的，发现极光的刀头真是一点不便宜，8 个刀头 200 元，基本上要 25 一个。 然后在检索信息时才知道舒适这个牌子，盒刀里份额排第二，但是之前一点没听过，新出的 pro 外形不错，135 买了一个刀架加五个刀头，又花了 110 买了 8 个刀头，如果不买新款刀头，水次元 5 刀头大概 10 元一个。 剃须体验上和锋隐致护没什么区别，耐久度还有待观察，性价比目前来看绝对是比吉列高不少。 没用手动剃须之前以为手动省钱，其实手柄基本上是白送的，剃须泡沫和刀头才是厂家赚钱的地方。
